sentences.text: Someone's phone keeps buzzing during the alkalinity presentation, and the speaker finally pauses mid-sentence to glare. After the meeting adjourned, three members lingered to debate whether T5 bulbs still outgrow LEDs for sticks. By eleven the mop bucket sits abandoned while the whole cleaning crew watches the clownfish sleep. Grease from a hundred small palms fogs the lower panel by Friday night — every Friday night. Water clarity, Mr. Okafor likes to say, is the first course every guest is served. Month four of the salinity-probe calibration debate, the secretary noted wearily in the minutes. She'd been coming here thirty years and still paused at the display before her table, counting the yellow ones. Who brought the montipora with the bleached edge — was that shipping stress or a lighting burn? Raffle prizes this month: a wavemaker, a bucket of reef salt, and a gift card to the fish store on Route 9. I traded a golf-ball-sized hammer coral for two ricordea and still feel like I fleeced the poor kid. After close, Reuben squeegees the fingerprints off the aquarium in slow arcs, radio murmuring behind the host stand. Dave's zoanthid frags went in the first raffle round, and half the room groaned when the new guy won all three. Did anyone else notice the torch coral in Lena's photos doubling in size since March? The treasurer reported that proceeds from last month's coral auction would fund a PAR meter available for member loan. Cloudy again this morning, third time this month, and the owner is already on the phone with the filtration company. Her refractometer read 1.027, two points above the club's recommended salinity, which sparked twenty minutes of argument near the coffee urn. Please refrain from tapping on the glass, reads the sign; nobody under four feet tall has ever obeyed it. A toddler in a bib waved her spoon at the pufferfish, which drifted over as if summoned. "Run your blues at forty percent, tops," Priya insisted, jabbing at the spectrum chart taped to the whiteboard. He argued that dosing kalkwasser through a top-off pump beats two-part for small systems, and nobody at his table disagreed. Honestly? Half our Yelp photos are of the aquarium, not the food. Under the rec center's fluorescent lights, the frags in their labeled cups looked gray, nothing like the vendors' glamour shots. Under the lobby's dimmed chandeliers, the illuminated water throws wobbling blue ribbons across the ceiling tiles. Waiting parties drift toward the glow the way moths do, menus forgotten under their arms. We passed Miguel's phone around the circle, admiring a chalice coral lit purple under actinics. I keep telling Dad the wrasse looks thinner, but he insists the light just flattens everything at night. Bring dip for your new frags, people — last year's flatworm outbreak started at one of these swaps. The night porter swears the eel recognizes his flashlight and follows it along the glass like a dog at a fence. Hard to sell the snapper special when its cousin is making eye contact with the customers, the bartender muttered. Attendance hit forty-two, a club record, mostly because the raffle included a protein skimmer donated by the sponsor. What is the meaning of the word tank?
